title: ci: 7 scripts/tests node suites run in no workflow, so "only the nightly runs everything" misses them; wire every scripts/tests/*.test.mjs into CI by a check that fails when a new file is left out
description:
At edc3e937, these files are named in no .github/workflows file (checked by grepping each basename):
- scripts/tests/account-trust-docs.test.mjs
- agent-git-guard.test.mjs
- doctor-ps1.test.mjs
- postflight-owner-scope.test.mjs
- protected-agent-command.test.mjs
- serena-ignore.test.mjs
- team-launch-quoting.test.mjs
Also unwired: scripts/tests/mention-provenance.{sh,ps1}, which only mention_provenance_cases.py / mention-provenance-seed.py drive. (postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1} are covered, because postflight.{sh,ps1} run them.)

The human ruled on 2026-11-04 (18:10Z) that "only nightly should run all". task-669e6aff makes nightly.yml call ci.yml with full: true, so the nightly runs exactly ci.yml's set and these suites still run nowhere. architect-cd0ac706 spotted it while planning cb378fd8; governor input is comment-b433a3ae on 669e6aff.

Wire each suite where it fits:
- per-push/PR, if it is fast and within the PR budget;
- otherwise nightly-only, through 669e6aff's full: true switch.
Add a guard so a new scripts/tests/*.test.mjs can't fall out again. That is either a glob in the workflow or an assertion in 669e6aff's scripts/tests/ci-workflows.test.mjs: every scripts/tests/*.test.mjs is named by a workflow or sits in an explicit skip list with a reason. Decide on mention-provenance and record the decision.
definitionOfDone: Every scripts/tests/*.test.mjs at the landing commit runs in at least one workflow (per-push or nightly), or is in an explicit skip list that names a reason and, if it is broken, a fix row id.
A guard makes a new scripts/tests/*.test.mjs that no workflow runs and the skip list does not name a test failure. It is shown to kill a mutant: a temporary unwired file makes it fail.

Each newly wired suite passes in this row's gate on the engines CI runs it on. A suite that fails is fixed here if the fix is small. Otherwise it goes in the skip list with a filed fix row, and is not wired red.
The mention-provenance.{sh,ps1} decision (wire it nightly, or skip it with a reason) is recorded in the workflow or the skip list.
Per-push and PR CI gain only suites that keep the PR jobs within their current wall time plus at most a few minutes. Anything long is nightly-only.
checkRefs[0] finishes within 20 min on this host (GLOBAL gate-budget rail), and independent legs run in parallel.

implementationPlan.description:
Wire the unwired suites into .github/workflows/ci.yml, job build-all-platforms. Insert six steps immediately before the existing line `      - name: Test Bash landing and postflight runner` (unique in the file). Change nothing else in the file. The whole planned diff is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-5f5c/planned.diff (hunk 1 is this step) and the dry-run file is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-5f5c/dry/.github/workflows/ci.yml, both made at e53f5a5c by /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-5f5c/apply_edits.py. Apply it with your editing tool, never a shell copy (TOOL-witness rail). Insert exactly:
```
      - name: Test launcher helper suites
        # Folder-trust docs, the Serena ignore override and the fake proxy's get_commit_scope knobs.
        # Not macOS: these suites have not been run there.
        if: runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: node --test scripts/tests/account-trust-docs.test.mjs scripts/tests/postflight-owner-scope.test.mjs scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs

      - name: Test PowerShell doctor and team launch arguments
        # doctor.ps1's Run-Native and moe-team.ps1's Start-Process build native command lines (PowerShell 5.1 and 7).
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: node --test scripts/tests/doctor-ps1.test.mjs scripts/tests/team-launch-quoting.test.mjs

      - name: Test agent Git-write guard and protected agent command
        # About 2 min on ubuntu-latest (bash, plus pwsh 7 for the protected launch). Under Windows PowerShell 5.1
        # and PowerShell 7 the pair takes about 5-6 min on windows-latest, so Windows runs it only in the nightly.
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: node --test scripts/tests/agent-git-guard.test.mjs scripts/tests/protected-agent-command.test.mjs

      - name: Test agent Git-write guard and protected agent command (nightly)
        # About 5-6 min on windows-latest: only the nightly runs it there.
        if: inputs.full && runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: node --test scripts/tests/agent-git-guard.test.mjs scripts/tests/protected-agent-command.test.mjs

      - name: Test Bash routed-mention provenance
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: bash scripts/tests/mention-provenance.sh

      - name: Test PowerShell routed-mention provenance
        # -PowerShell picks the wrapper's host: Windows PowerShell 5.1, then PowerShell 7.
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/mention-provenance.ps1 -PowerShell powershell
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/mention-provenance.ps1 -PowerShell pwsh

```
Why this layout:
- The Windows heavy pair (agent-git-guard plus protected-agent-command) took 191-199 s here under Windows node with its PowerShell 5.1 and 7 rows. That is about 5-6 min on windows-latest, using hunt #25's runner factor of 1.6-1.9x against this desktop. It would push the Windows PR job (about 16 min) past 'a few minutes' (DoD 5), so Windows runs it only in the nightly. Linux runs the pair per push: 72 s here with pwsh 7, about 2 min on ubuntu-latest. The ubuntu job stays far below the Windows job, so PR wall time does not move for it.
- Do NOT fold doctor-ps1 or team-launch-quoting into 'Test PowerShell daemon autostart arguments'. That step is red on PR #230 (runs 41894749395 and 41895358687; fix row task-e5211efd, filed during this planning), and a shared step would wire the new files red (DoD 3).
- doctor-ps1 and team-launch-quoting skip off Windows by their own reasons, so they get a Windows step. The three helper suites run on Linux and Windows.
- macOS runs none of the new steps. None of these suites has been run there, and this host cannot run macOS, so the gate could not prove them (DoD 3).
- mention-provenance (the DoD 4 decision): wired per push, not skipped. Here it took 13 s under bash and 8-9 s per PowerShell engine, and all three PASSED. -PowerShell picks the wrapper's host, so each engine runs as both parent and child, as CI's pwsh step shell -> powershell chain does.
Measured PR cost (local time x 1.6-1.9): ubuntu +2.5-3 min (about 6.4 -> 9-9.5 min), windows +1.5 min (about 16 -> 17.5 min), macOS +0. The nightly Windows job gains 5-6 min.
Error handling: every new step fails its job on a failing suite. A single `node --test` exits non-zero on any failing row. The PowerShell block stops after a failed 5.1 run at the LASTEXITCODE line, and GitHub's pwsh wrapper returns the last native exit code. Add no continue-on-error and no `|| true`. A provenance harness SKIPs with exit 0 when node, python 3 or timeout is missing, but the hosted runners have all three (setup-node, python 3, coreutils), and the gate requires all three PASSED lines locally.

comments.content:
Planning input from the governor, 19:16Z. architect-cd0ac706's sketch (msg-b0e8402a) is the intended shape for this row. It was written for 669e6aff, but that row stays at revision 1:
1. The nightly runs every scripts/tests/*.test.mjs by a glob, not a hand list. Every skipped file is listed with its reason. A mechanical check fails when a *.test.mjs is neither run nor skip-listed. Extend the scripts/tests/ci-workflows.test.mjs that 669e6aff lands.
2. mention-provenance.{sh,ps1}: decide whether the nightly runs them through mention_provenance_cases.py / mention-provenance-seed.py or skip-lists them, and record the decision either way.
3. postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1} need no entry, because the nightly's full postflight.{sh,ps1} sources them.
4. Per-push only when a fast PR job already exercises the file's surface within budget.
Time the gate once at plan time. It must fit 20 min.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: Every scripts/tests/*.test.mjs runs in CI. Per push and on PRs, ubuntu and windows run the 7 previously unwired suites where they are fast: the helper trio on both, doctor-ps1 and team-launch-quoting on Windows, and the agent Git-write guard plus protected agent command pair on Linux. On Windows that pair runs only in the nightly (ci.yml with full: true). mention-provenance.{sh,ps1} run per push: bash on Linux, PowerShell 5.1 and 7 on Windows. scripts/tests/ci-workflows.test.mjs R7 fails when a scripts/tests/*.test.mjs is named by no ci.yml `node --test` step and SKIP does not list it with a reason.
acceptanceCriteria: At the landing commit every scripts/tests/*.test.mjs is named by a ci.yml `node --test` step (per push or nightly-only), or SKIP lists it with a reason and, for a broken suite, a fix row id.
R7 fails on an unwired new *.test.mjs: ref0 proves it with a temp zz-unwired.test.mjs.

Every newly wired suite passes in the gate on each engine CI runs it on: Linux node with bash and pwsh 7; Windows node under pwsh with PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7 and Git Bash. No row may skip for a missing engine.
mention-provenance.sh and mention-provenance.ps1 (both engines) are wired per push, and FAST in ci-workflows.test.mjs pins them.
No per-push step that runs on Windows names agent-git-guard.test.mjs or protected-agent-command.test.mjs; measured PR cost is ubuntu +2.5-3 min, windows +1.5 min, macOS +0.
The joined checkRefs finish within 20 min on this host (3m17s-3m22s measured), and the gate's legs run in parallel.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Approaches rejected:
  - A glob step (`node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`, the governor's first idea). It would run the Windows-heavy pair and every OS-specific suite on every OS per push, and it breaks the per-step OS split that ci.yml and the CI-reading rows depend on. The guard is a test instead (R7), which the DoD allows.
  - Everything nightly-only. The suites are cheap on Linux, and per-push catches launcher regressions hours earlier.
  - Skipping protected-agent-command's PowerShell 7 rows on Linux CI with --test-skip-pattern. They pass on Linux pwsh 7.6.9, and ubuntu-latest ships pwsh. The gate gets a Linux pwsh from a local copy instead.
  - Folding doctor-ps1 and team-launch-quoting into the daemon-autostart step. That step is red (task-e5211efd).
  - Wiring macOS: unprovable here.
- R2's exact-command check alone missed a heavy file added to a Windows PR step under another command line (a planning mutant survived), so R2 also gets a per-file loop.
- The SKIP list stays empty. The file-level escape hatch is DoD 1's, with its fix-row rule.
- The non-.test.mjs manual harnesses (wave1-pilot.mjs and worktree-e2e.cjs, both manual and opt-in by their own headers) are out of this row's scope.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- The gate must mirror CI's Windows process chain. windows-latest runs a step under pwsh, so node and every powershell.exe it spawns inherit pwsh's PSModulePath. A node.exe started straight from WSL gets a clean one and can hide CI-only failures (see mem:decision-mid-epic-launcher-gate-narrow on Get-FileHash). ref1 therefore runs `pwsh.exe -nop -c "node --test ..."`.
- .gitattributes forces eol=lf on Windows checkouts too, so a git-archive snapshot on D: matches CI's checkout.
- The CurrentUser execution policy is RemoteSigned, so `powershell -File` runs the local harness the way CI does, without -ExecutionPolicy.
- node 24's spec reporter prints the actual array of a failed deepEqual, which is what ref0's grep for 'zz-unwired.test.mjs' relies on.
- The 9 CI-reading rows of other files read only the local-runner, daemon-json-cap and node-version lines, none of which this change touches. ref0 still re-runs them.
- Planning artifacts are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-5f5c/: apply_edits.py, planned.diff, mutants.sh, ref0.txt, ref1.txt, gate.txt, dry/ (the edited clone) and wtsim/ (a worktree simulation).
planningNotes.risks:
- task-c199e177 (WORKING) adds rows to protected-agent-command.test.mjs. If it lands first, W includes them and this gate runs them on Linux pwsh 7 as well. If they fail there only, follow step 4's red-run rule.
- ubuntu-latest's pwsh is 7.4 or 7.5, not 7.6.9. The PowerShell 7 rows match launcher Write-Host lines, not ConciseView error text, so the version gap is a low risk. The governor's watch of the first PR #230 run is the real proof.
- serena-ignore F3 row 8 (a symlinked project.local.yml) skips here on EPERM. It may run for the first time on windows-latest, which can create symlinks. It shares the Linux code path that passes.
- If the control checkout holds dirty bytes, QA's in-place re-run tests them. Step 4 gives the clone route.
- /tmp/hunt-9ca9/pwsh is wiped at a WSL restart. The D: copy is the fallback, and a missing Linux pwsh fails the gate loudly, never silently.
- If ci.yml changes before the worker starts (task-669e6aff QA, task-e5211efd), re-anchor on the step names.
